objective: Reduce native-4K ground texel/PBR risk by preserving approved physical-data precision through Unity import without awarding visual points before real rendered pixels exist.

investigation.selectedIssue: QualityBlockGroundMicrodetailUpgrade authors four 1024x1024 physical micro-surface sets with millimetre-scale normal relief and bounded metallic/smoothness signals, but its generated normal and metallic/smoothness maps are imported using CompressedHQ. Existing ground microdetail validation checks texture type, linear masks, resolution, bindings and metric scale, while generic texture-sampling QA addresses mips/filtering/aniso but does not make these eight physical-data maps uncompressed or reject Standalone overrides.
investigation.risk: Block compression or a platform override can quantize tangent-space normal orientation and metallic/smoothness values before frontal/oblique/grazing native-4K evidence is produced. This can flatten subtle zinc/cast/mineral relief, alter highlight width and increase grazing instability even when the source PNG and material ranges are correct.
investigation.scopeDecision: Only the eight normal and metallic/smoothness physical-data maps are forced lossless. Ground albedo maps remain outside this requirement to avoid paying uncompressed memory cost for a lower-frequency colour signal that does not carry the same normal/roughness precision risk.

changes.summary: Upgraded the machine-readable ground contract to v1.1.0 with an explicit import-precision policy: Uncompressed, Crunch off, no Standalone override, >=1024, mipmapped, Repeat, Trilinear, anisotropy>=8, linear physical data, canonical NormalMap/Default types, source alpha preservation, formal read-only pre-cull and zero automatic Visual Fidelity points. Added corresponding failure injections.

Added preparation-time repair and formal-camera read-only/fail-closed validation for four ground normals plus four metallic/smoothness maps. Reimports covered physical-data maps as Uncompressed, disables Crunch and Standalone override, preserves 1024 runtime dimensions/mips/Repeat/Trilinear/aniso, enforces linear data and texture-type semantics, and reasserts precision after generated-source imports.

formalEvidenceBehavior.preparation: May repair covered importer state after generated texture imports and after the benchmark scene is saved.
formalEvidenceBehavior.formalPreCull: Read-only. QA4K_, QATemporal_ and QAPreparedTemporal_ target captures are blocked if any covered importer/runtime texture is noncanonical.
formalEvidenceBehavior.visualScoring: No automatic points. Actual 3840x2160 frontal/oblique/grazing frames, 100-percent ground/material crops and temporal grazing evidence remain mandatory for visual credit.
formalEvidenceBehavior.albedoPolicy: Ground albedo stays outside the Uncompressed requirement; this gate is intentionally scoped to high-value physical-data precision.

failureInjection: CompressedHQ on any covered normal or metallic/smoothness map
ground normal imported as Default instead of NormalMap
metallic/smoothness map imported with noncanonical type
